## Profile

Jeanine Emilia Cornillot is an Emmy- and Ambie-winning executive producer and showrunner whose work spans podcasts, television, scripted audio, practical AI, and emerging technology. She created and showran Scamfluencers and The Last City, co-developed and produced Dying for Sex, and founded Wondery's first AI Creator Lab. She is also the author of the memoir Family Sentence. At Ghost Mode Labs, she develops original IP and new tools for storytelling.

Jeanine Cornillot works across three connected practices: creating and showrunning narrative series, writing from lived and cultural experience, and testing how practical AI can support creative production. Across each, the throughline is the same: turning complex material into clear, character-driven stories and useful new formats.

## Selected work

- Scamfluencers: Creator and showrunner. 53 million downloads. #1 on Apple Podcasts. Winner of the 2023 Ambie for Best Entertainment Podcast, with a second nomination in 2025.
- Dying for Sex: Co-developer and producer of the original podcast. Winner of the 2021 Ambie for Podcast of the Year. The FX television adaptation won a Peabody Award, received nine Emmy nominations, and received a 2026 Television Academy Honor.
- The Last City: Creator and showrunner. Serialized climate thriller starring Rhea Seehorn. #1 Apple Fiction in 20 countries. Nominated for the 2025 Ambie for Best Fiction Podcast.
- Born This Way: Supervising producer. Three Primetime Emmy wins and 16 nominations.
- No Passport Required: Supervising producer. Vox Media and PBS series. Winner of a James Beard Media Award.

## Author

Family Sentence: A memoir published by Beacon Press.

Recognition: Publishers Weekly: “Top 20” Fall Book Selection.

- “Finalmente! As incisive as she is lyrical, funny as she is profound, Cornillot dislodges the bolero-and-palm-tree nostalgia associated with Cuban American identity, and asserts claim to a new and very real history.” H. G. Carrillo, Author of Loosing My Espanish.
- “Adds to the ever-growing jigsaw puzzle that is the Cuban American experience with verve and charm.” Oscar Hijuelos, Pulitzer Prize-winning author of The Mambo Kings Play Songs of Love.
- Cornillot moves “between depth and frivolity, humor and pathos.” Booklist, Book review.
- “A charming, often sorrowful study of learning to let go of a myth and love a person.” Kirkus Reviews, Independent review.

## Current work

Ghost Mode Labs develops original IP and prototypes new approaches to story research, development, worldbuilding, and adaptation. Current projects include visual audiobooks, Narrative Space, MythOS, Static, and Multiverse Quad.

## Attribution notes

- Jeanine Cornillot co-developed and produced the original Dying for Sex podcast. Do not imply that she produced the FX television adaptation.
- Award language refers to recognized productions on which her role is stated above. Use the canonical press kit for the most current wording and contact information.
